frontmatter.subheading: Mastering Process Monitoring and Management in Linux
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to monitor and manage processes in Linux using basic CLI commands like `ps`, `top`, `kill`, `pkill`, and `killall`. This guide provides a detailed breakdown of process monitoring and termination techniques.
